user.description: Add the Ski Resort Recommender. Afterwards, set your home station, ski days and the other settings with **Configure**.

abort.single_instance_allowed: The Ski Resort Recommender is already set up.

init.title: Ski Resort Recommender settings
init.description: Train connections come from the SBB timetable (transport.opendata.ch), the weather from Open-Meteo.

data.min_good_score: Minimum score for a good day

data_description.travel_modes: Train, car or both (both: both are shown, the faster one counts for the score). The car trip starts at the home location of Home Assistant; drive times without traffic (OSRM).
data_description.electric_car: Only with car: shows the public chargers at the car parks (number and kW, data of the Swiss Federal Office of Energy; not every charger is listed, none in Austria).
data_description.home_station: Your train station as in the SBB timetable, e.g. Zürich HB. Leave empty for no train connections.
data_description.show_outlook: Adds the best day 6-7 days ahead as an extra entry (less reliable forecast). The full list in the card shows these days either way.
data_description.min_good_score: Days with at least this score (0-100) count as good.
data_description.arrival_target: The connection arriving closest to this time wins.
data_description.weather_interval_hours: Open-Meteo is asked at most this often. Raise it if the weather service rate-limits.

error.station_not_found: Station not found in the SBB timetable. Did you mean: {suggestions}
error.arrival_window: The arrival times must be in order: from <= preferred <= until.
error.no_weekday: Choose at least one ski day.
error.cannot_connect: The SBB timetable could not be reached to check the station. Try again later.
